items.title: Salesforce Lost 16% in a Week as AI Fears Hit Software. Piper Sandler Sees 53% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSalesforce stock fell 16% in a week as investors sold software ahead of Anthropic’s IPO, and ServiceNow fell less. Salesforce will probably sell its Anthropic stake to pay down the debt from its $25 billion buyback.

items.title: AI sell-off: These sectors held firm as tech slumped in Oct, Nov
items.summary: Investing.com -- Semiconductors, software, and memory stocks fell hard through October and early-November amid mounting questions over the long-term artificial intelligence trade.

items.title: ServiceNow vs. UiPath: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: ServiceNow's revenue top $15 billion while UiPath trades at a lower forward multiple, but the gap between the two growth stories may matter more than price.

items.title: UiPath's ARR Nears $2 Billion: Can It Sustain the Growth Momentum?
items.summary: PATH's ARR climbs 12.5% to $1.94 billion in Q2 fiscal 2027, with annual gains accelerating. Can wider enterprise deployments sustain the momentum?

items.title: Atlassian’s CEO Puts $8 Million Into the Stock While Other Executives Sell. Here’s What That Tells Investors
items.summary: Atlassian's founder kept buying while the stock cratered, and three executives sold shares the same day. The filings reveal why the buying and selling are not the opposing signals they appear to be, and what to watch next.

items.title: Is ServiceNow A Better Buy Than Atlassian Now?
items.summary: Our Nov 18 look at Atlassian found the stock fell 6.0% on Tuesday, Nov 17, while the S&P 500 lost 1.0%. The company had no news that day. Yet 57 of the 62 other application software companies we track fell too. For that story, see What Explains The Move In Atlassian Stock.

items.title: Do Wall Street Analysts Like ServiceNow Stock?
items.summary: ServiceNow has lagged behind the broader market over the past year, yet analysts remain highly optimistic about the stock’s prospects.
